cases.sentence: Действительно, всё было приготовлено на славу: ___ был накрыт даже довольно чисто, посуда, вилки, ножи, рюмки, стаканы, чашки — всё это, конечно, было сборное.
cases.translation: Indeed, everything had been prepared splendidly: the table was set quite neatly, the dishes, forks, knives, glasses, tumblers, cups — all of it, of course, mismatched and of every shape and size.
cases.explain: "Стол" is the subject of "был накрыт" (was set), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Раскольников вошел почти в ту самую минуту, как воротились с ___.
cases.translation: Raskolnikov came in almost the very moment they returned from the cemetery.
cases.explain: The preposition "с" (from/back from) governs the genitive case, giving "кладбища."

cases.sentence: К ___ же, то есть к закуске, явились из них всё самые незначительные и бедные, многие из них не в своем даже виде.
cases.translation: As for the memorial dinner, that is, the refreshments, only the most insignificant and poor among them came, many not even properly dressed.
cases.explain: The preposition "к" (to/for) governs the dative case, giving "поминкам."

cases.sentence: Раскольников вошел почти в ту самую ___, как воротились с кладбища.
cases.translation: Raskolnikov came in almost the very moment they returned from the cemetery.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" in this temporal expression governs the accusative case, giving "минуту."

cases.sentence: Затем она еще раз гордо и с ___ осмотрела своих гостей.
cases.translation: Then once more she proudly and with dignity looked over her guests.
cases.explain: The preposition "с" (with) governs the instrumental case, giving "достоинством."

cases.sentence: Амалия Ивановна встретила возвратившихся даже с некоторою гордостию, вся разодетая, в ___ с новыми траурными лентами и в черном платье.
cases.translation: Amalia Ivanovna met the returning guests even with a certain pride, all dressed up, in a cap with new mourning ribbons and in a black dress.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" marking what she was wearing governs the prepositional case, giving "чепце."

reading.ru: Трудно было бы в точности обозначить причины, вследствие которых в расстроенной голове Катерины Ивановны зародилась идея этих бестолковых поминок.
reading.question: What does the narrator say is hard to pinpoint about Katerina Ivanovna's memorial dinner?
options: The exact reasons why the idea of this senseless memorial dinner arose in her disturbed mind
The exact cost of the dinner
reading.correct: The exact reasons why the idea of this senseless memorial dinner arose in her disturbed mind
reading.explain: The narrator says it would be hard to state precisely why this pointless memorial dinner occurred to her disordered mind.

reading.ru: Действительно, на них ухлопаны были чуть ли не десять рублей из двадцати с лишком, полученных от Раскольникова собственно на похороны Мармеладова.
reading.question: How much money was spent on the dinner out of what Raskolnikov had given?
options: Nearly ten rubles of the more than twenty rubles received
All of it, over twenty rubles
reading.correct: Nearly ten rubles of the more than twenty rubles received
reading.explain: Almost ten of the twenty-odd rubles Raskolnikov gave for Marmeladov's funeral were spent on the dinner.

reading.ru: Сверх того Сонечка весьма основательно про нее говорила, что у ней ум мешается.
reading.question: What does Sonya reasonably say about Katerina Ivanovna's state of mind?
options: That her mind is becoming unhinged
That she is only pretending to be upset
reading.correct: That her mind is becoming unhinged
reading.explain: Sonya says, quite reasonably, that Katerina Ivanovna's mind is becoming deranged.

reading.ru: Сильное развитие чахотки, как говорят медики, тоже способствует помешательству умственных способностей.
reading.question: According to doctors, what else contributes to Katerina Ivanovna's mental disturbance?
options: The severe progress of her consumption (tuberculosis)
reading.correct: The severe progress of her consumption (tuberculosis)
reading.explain: The narrator notes that doctors say advanced consumption also contributes to derangement of the mental faculties.

reading.ru: Вин во множественном числе и многоразличных сортов не было, мадеры тоже: это было преувеличено, но вино было.
reading.question: What is actually true about the variety of wines at the dinner?
options: There was no great variety or fine sorts, though wine was present
There were dozens of rare vintages
There was no alcohol at all
reading.correct: There was no great variety or fine sorts, though wine was present
reading.explain: The narrator clarifies that claims of many kinds of wine and madeira were exaggerated, but there was wine.

reading.ru: Закупками распорядилась сама Катерина Ивановна, с помощию одного жильца, какого-то жалкого полячка
reading.question: Who helps Katerina Ivanovna with the shopping for the dinner?
reading.correct: A wretched Polish lodger
reading.explain: Katerina Ivanovna herself managed the shopping, with the help of a pitiful little Polish lodger.

reading.ru: В свойстве характера Катерины Ивановны было поскорее нарядить первого встречного и поперечного в самые лучшие и яркие краски
reading.question: What tendency in Katerina Ivanovna's character does the narrator describe?
options: To quickly praise any stranger extravagantly, then just as suddenly turn on them
To always stay silent in company
reading.correct: To quickly praise any stranger extravagantly, then just as suddenly turn on them
reading.explain: It was in Katerina Ivanovna's character to quickly dress up any random person in the brightest colors of praise, only to later turn on them.

reading.ru: Действительно, всё было приготовлено на славу: стол был накрыт даже довольно чисто, посуда, вилки, ножи, рюмки, стаканы, чашки
reading.question: How was the table ultimately arranged, despite the mismatched dishes?
options: It was set quite neatly and splendidly by the appointed time
It collapsed under the weight of food
It was set only for two people
reading.correct: It was set quite neatly and splendidly by the appointed time
reading.explain: Everything was indeed prepared splendidly, with the table set quite neatly, despite the mismatched dishes.

reading.ru: Петр Петрович Лужин, например, самый, можно сказать, солиднейший из всех жильцов, не явился
reading.question: Who among the solid, respectable tenants notably failed to appear at the dinner?
reading.correct: Pyotr Petrovich Luzhin
reading.explain: Pyotr Petrovich Luzhin, the most respectable of all the tenants, did not show up.

reading.ru: Не пришел тоже и толстый подполковник (в сущности, отставной штабс-капитан), но оказалось, что он «без задних ног» еще со вчерашнего утра.
reading.question: Why did the fat lieutenant colonel (former staff-captain) fail to attend?
options: He had been dead drunk since the previous morning
reading.correct: He had been dead drunk since the previous morning
reading.explain: The fat lieutenant colonel also failed to come, having been "dead drunk" since the morning before.

reading.ru: Даже детей, чтобы выгадать место, посадили не за стол, и без того занявший всю комнату, а накрыли им в заднем углу на сундуке
reading.question: Where were the children seated during the dinner?
options: In the back corner on a chest, since the table took up the whole room
At the head of the table
reading.correct: In the back corner on a chest, since the table took up the whole room
reading.explain: To save space, the children were not seated at the table but were served in the back corner on a chest.

reading.ru: Раскольников вошел почти в ту самую минуту, как воротились с кладбища.
reading.question: When did Raskolnikov arrive?
options: Almost the very moment the mourners returned from the cemetery
reading.correct: Almost the very moment the mourners returned from the cemetery
reading.explain: Raskolnikov comes in almost the exact moment the mourners return from the cemetery.

reading.ru: Катерина Ивановна ужасно обрадовалась ему, во-первых, потому, что он был единственный «образованный гость» из всех гостей
reading.question: Why was Katerina Ivanovna especially delighted to see Raskolnikov?
options: Because he was the only "educated guest" among all the guests
Because he was the wealthiest guest
reading.correct: Because he was the only "educated guest" among all the guests
reading.explain: Katerina Ivanovna is thrilled because he is the only "educated guest" among all those present.

reading.ru: Во всем эта кукушка виновата. Вы понимаете, о ком я говорю: об ней, об ней!
reading.question: Whom does Katerina Ivanovna mock as a "cuckoo" while whispering to Raskolnikov?
reading.correct: Amalia Ivanovna, the landlady
reading.explain: Katerina Ivanovna whispers that this "cuckoo" — meaning Amalia Ivanovna — is to blame for everything.

reading.ru: Тут смех опять превратился в нестерпимый кашель, продолжавшийся пять минут.
reading.question: What physical symptom interrupts Katerina Ivanovna's laughter?
options: A fit of unbearable coughing lasting five minutes
reading.correct: A fit of unbearable coughing lasting five minutes
reading.explain: Her laughter turns into an unbearable coughing fit that lasts five minutes.

reading.ru: На платке осталось несколько крови, на лбу выступили капли пота.
reading.question: What does Katerina Ivanovna show Raskolnikov after her coughing fit?
options: A few spots of blood on her handkerchief
reading.correct: A few spots of blood on her handkerchief
reading.explain: Some blood remains on her handkerchief and drops of sweat appear on her forehead after the coughing fit.

reading.ru: Соня поспешила тотчас же передать ей извинение Петра Петровича
reading.question: What message does Sonya deliver at the table?
options: Pyotr Petrovich's apology for not being able to attend
reading.correct: Pyotr Petrovich's apology for not being able to attend
reading.explain: Sonya hurries to relay Pyotr Petrovich's apology for being unable to come.

reading.ru: Она села подле Раскольникова, которому наскоро поклонилась, и мельком, любопытно на него поглядела.
reading.question: How does Sonya behave when she sits down next to Raskolnikov?
options: She bows to him quickly and glances at him curiously
reading.correct: She bows to him quickly and glances at him curiously
reading.explain: Sonya sits beside Raskolnikov, bowing to him hastily and glancing at him curiously in passing.

reading.ru: Да-с, любил-с выпить; это любили-с, пивали-с! — крикнул вдруг отставной провиантский, осушая двенадцатую рюмку водки.
reading.question: What does the drunk retired quartermaster keep doing throughout the dinner?
options: Draining glass after glass of vodka
reading.correct: Draining glass after glass of vodka
reading.explain: The retired quartermaster shouts about drinking while downing his twelfth glass of vodka.

reading.ru: Вообразите, Родион Романович, в кармане у него пряничного петушка нашли: мертво-пьяный идет, а про детей помнит.
reading.question: What touching detail does Katerina Ivanovna recall about her late husband?
options: That a gingerbread cockerel was found in his pocket, showing he thought of the children even drunk
That he never drank at all
That he wrote her love letters daily
That he saved a large sum of money
reading.correct: That a gingerbread cockerel was found in his pocket, showing he thought of the children even drunk
reading.explain: Katerina Ivanovna recalls that a gingerbread cockerel was found in his pocket, proof he remembered the children even dead drunk.

reading.ru: Раскольников сидел и слушал молча и с отвращением.
reading.question: How does Raskolnikov behave throughout most of the dinner?
options: He sits silently, listening with disgust
reading.correct: He sits silently, listening with disgust
reading.explain: Raskolnikov sits listening in silence and with disgust at the scene unfolding around him.

reading.ru: Как нарочно, кто-то переслал с другого конца стола Соне тарелку, с вылепленными на ней, из черного хлеба, двумя сердцами, пронзенными стрелой.
reading.question: What odd object does someone send down the table to Sonya?
options: A plate with two hearts pierced by an arrow, molded from black bread
reading.correct: A plate with two hearts pierced by an arrow, molded from black bread
reading.explain: Someone mockingly sends Sonya a plate with two hearts pierced by an arrow, molded out of black bread.

reading.ru: Похвальный лист этот, очевидно, должен был теперь послужить свидетельством о праве Катерины Ивановны самой завести пансион
reading.question: What is the "certificate of merit" (похвальный лист) meant to prove?
options: Katerina Ivanovna's right to open her own boarding school for young ladies
reading.correct: Katerina Ivanovna's right to open her own boarding school for young ladies
reading.explain: The certificate is meant to serve as proof of Katerina Ivanovna's right to found her own school for young ladies.

reading.ru: Катерина Ивановна вдруг расплакалась, тут же заметив про самое себя, что «она слабонервная дура и что уж слишком расстроена, что пора кончать, и так как закуска уж кончена, то разносить бы чай».
reading.question: What does Katerina Ivanovna admit about herself right after bursting into tears?
options: That she is a "nervous fool" who has become too overwrought
That she wants to leave the city
That she blames Sonya for everything
reading.correct: That she is a "nervous fool" who has become too overwrought
reading.explain: Katerina Ivanovna suddenly bursts into tears, remarking about herself that she is a nervous fool, too overwrought, and that it is time to finish and serve tea.

reading.ru: В эту минуту отворилась дверь, и на пороге комнаты вдруг показался Петр Петрович Лужин.
reading.question: What interrupts the dinner's descent into chaos at the chapter's end?
options: Pyotr Petrovich Luzhin suddenly appears in the doorway
reading.correct: Pyotr Petrovich Luzhin suddenly appears in the doorway
reading.explain: At that moment the door opens, and Pyotr Petrovich Luzhin suddenly appears on the threshold.
